parts.name: Cylinder Head
parts.description: The cast top section of the engine that closes off both cylinders. It carries the intake and exhaust ports, the valves and the two overhead camshafts.
parts.function: Forms the top of each combustion chamber and houses the valve train that lets the fuel-air mixture in and the exhaust gas out at the right moments.
parts.verificationNote: Honda's 2026 specifications list a DOHC valve train with four valves per cylinder, which the head carries.

oem.note: Diagram name listed in the 2026 Rebel 500 catalog index (SE listing). Part numbers not yet verified for 2026 CMX500A.

parts.name: Cylinder Head Cover
parts.description: The cover (often called the valve cover) bolted to the top of the cylinder head.
parts.function: Seals the camshafts and valve train in so their lubricating oil stays inside the engine and dirt stays out.

parts.name: Camshafts / Valves
parts.description: Two overhead camshafts (one for intake valves, one for exhaust valves) and eight valves in total — four per cylinder.
parts.function: The camshafts' lobes push the valves open in time with the crankshaft so each cylinder can breathe in fuel and air and breathe out exhaust.

parts.name: Cam Chain / Tensioner
parts.description: A chain that links the crankshaft to the camshafts, plus a tensioner that keeps the chain taut.
parts.function: Keeps camshaft rotation locked in time with the crankshaft so valves open and close at the right moment in each stroke.
parts.verificationNote: Diagram listed in the 2026 Rebel 500 catalog index; internal routing not yet verified for 2026 CMX500A.

parts.name: Cylinders / Pistons
parts.description: Two side-by-side cylinders (a parallel twin), each with a piston that slides up and down inside it.
parts.function: Each piston is driven down by the burning fuel-air charge; that push is what ultimately turns the crankshaft.

parts.name: Pistons / Rings
parts.description: Two pistons (one per cylinder) with piston rings that seal against the cylinder walls.
parts.function: Turn combustion pressure into a downward force on the connecting rods, while the rings stop gas leaking past and scrape excess oil from the cylinder walls.
parts.verificationNote: Piston diameter follows the 67.0 mm bore published by Honda. Ring sets and part numbers not yet verified for 2026 CMX500A.

parts.name: Crankshaft
parts.description: The rotating shaft in the bottom of the engine that the connecting rods turn. Its throw sets the 66.8 mm stroke.
parts.function: Converts the pistons' up-and-down motion into rotation. Power then flows from the crankshaft to the clutch, the transmission and the chain.
parts.verificationNote: Stroke is published by Honda. Crank phasing, balancer details and part numbers not yet verified for 2026 CMX500A.

parts.name: Crankcase
parts.description: The main lower engine casting. It holds the crankshaft, the transmission shafts and the engine oil.
parts.function: The structural core of the engine. It aligns the rotating shafts, contains the oil and provides the points where the frame holds the engine.

parts.name: Engine Covers
parts.description: Side covers bolted to the left and right of the crankcase.
parts.function: Seal the rotating parts on each end of the crankcase inside an oil-tight housing and protect them from road debris.

parts.name: Alternator (Left Crankcase) Cover
parts.description: The cover that encloses the generator (alternator), as its Honda diagram name indicates.
parts.function: Houses and protects the generator that charges the battery and powers the electrical system.
parts.verificationNote: The left-side position shown is representative and not yet verified for 2026 CMX500A.

parts.name: Right Crankcase Cover
parts.description: The cover on the right side of the crankcase.
parts.function: Seals the right-hand end of the crankcase. Which components sit behind it on the 2026 CMX500A has not yet been verified from Honda sources.

parts.name: Lubrication
parts.description: The engine oil system, with an oil pan (sump), an oil pump and oil filtration.
parts.function: Pumps oil under pressure to the bearings, the camshafts and the transmission, cooling and protecting every moving part. In a wet-clutch engine like this one, the same oil also bathes the clutch.

parts.name: Oil Pan / Oil Pump
parts.description: The oil reservoir at the bottom of the engine and the pump that draws oil out of it.
parts.function: The pan collects oil as it drains back down. The pump picks it up and sends it under pressure through the engine's oil passages.

parts.name: Oil Filter
parts.description: Filters engine oil. Its Honda part number, diagram and location are not yet verified for 2026 CMX500A.
parts.function: Traps metal particles and combustion by-products so that clean oil reaches the bearings.

parts.name: Starting Clutch
parts.description: A one-way clutch with gears that connects the electric starter motor to the crankshaft.
parts.function: Lets the starter motor spin the engine to start it, then freewheels once the engine runs so the engine never drives the starter.
